entry.title: UPDATED: Cancelled Dual Purpose First Meetup – Bakfiets Unite!

link.title: UPDATED: Cancelled Dual Purpose First Meetup – Bakfiets Unite!

entry.content:
Egads, the weather!

Needless to say, because of the weather (?) the meetup was canceled on account of the underlying event cancellation. For more details, check out Move Redmond’s page here.

Past post below…

Coming up on the 13th and 14th of January, in this grand upcoming year of 2024, Move Redmond is organizing an event around station access mapping that to me, seems like bakfiets riders really need to be involved in! For more details from the Move Redmond emailer, check out this link.

I signed up for Saturday and Sunday, and wanted to open up the invite and maybe we could even make it a “Bakfiets Rider Gathering” and discuss the station access mapping and future meetups for riders. The specific times and locations I signed up for are…

Sat 1/13 10:00-12:00 @ South Bellevue, then Sunday 1/14 10:00-12:00 @ Overlake Village. I look forward to seeing others there, cheers!
entry.summary: Move Redmond is organizing a station access mapping event on the 13th and 14th of January 2024. The event is seen as an opportunity for Bakfiets riders to participate and discuss future meetups. It will be held on both days from 10:00-12:00, at South Bellevue and Overlake Village respectively.

entry.title: Welcome to bakfiets fam
entry.content:
First thing first, since it is Dutch, the word bakfiet just means “Cargo Bike”. This is a range of bikes, but more on that later, suffice to say it’s a bike that carries significantly more than merely a rider!

Fam is short for “Family”, in this case our chosen family of cargo carrying crew! Sometimes we expand our family and friends to new and like minded souls, that’s what this site and future meets are all about. Sharing knowledge, ideas, experiences, and the joy of cargo bikes and the freedom that comes along with them!

Finally, hi, I’m Adron your host and currently the *administrator* of this site. I live and breath the biking life, car free for a whole bunch of years, and just working and living life with my wife and son here in Redmond, Washington.

Hope you’ll join us…

….for upcoming Bakfiet Meets, discussion of cargo bikes, plotting and planning cargo bike technologies, advancements, and all the like! Welcome!
entry.summary: Welcome to the Bakfiets Fam a Seattle area cargo bike blog and meetup. Hope you’ll subscribe and join us for upcoming events and general bike fam discussions and get togethers.
